parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>

parameters.description_en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
2. In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and view the ID in the address bar.
parameters.description_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
